voice.auth: Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY (read from .env, never print it)
voice.modelFallbackDiscovery: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models?output_modalities=speech — pick a model that supports the `instructions` field and a deep male English voice; check its `supported_voices`.

voiceTest.rule: Generate the test lines for every candidate, then ask the user once which voice to use. If the user does not answer, use voiceDefault.

voice.instructions: Low, calm, adult male narrator. A government official reading a routine advisory. Flat and deadpan, unhurried, precise diction, no drama, no smiling, no whispering. Slight weight on the final word of each sentence. Short sentences are delivered as complete statements, not trailing off.
voice.slipInstructions: Same voice, but a fraction warmer and quieter, as if the narrator forgot himself for a moment.
voice.granularity: One request per line. Send `voice` text exactly as written in scenes.json (numbers are already spelled out). Save as audio/lines/<lineId>.mp3. Skip lines that already exist. Concurrency 4, retry up to 3 times with backoff on non-200.
voice.notes: If gpt-4o-mini-tts rejects `speed`, omit it. Keep the generation id (X-Generation-Id header) per line in reports/tts-log.json.

verification.request: JSON body: { model, input_audio: { data: <base64>, format: 'mp3' }, language: 'en', response_format: 'verbose_json', timestamp_granularities: ['word'] }
verification.rule: Transcribe every line file. Normalise both texts (lowercase, strip punctuation, spell numbers as words). If word error rate > 0.15, regenerate that line (max 2 extra attempts) and log it in reports/stt-check.json. Also store the first and last word timestamps to trim leading/trailing silence longer than 0.15 s.

timing.formula: start[0] = leadInSec; start[n+1] = start[n] + trimmedAudioDuration[n] + pauseAfter[n]
timing.endCard: END shot starts at start[last] + duration[last] + pauseAfter[last] and holds 3.0 s
timing.output: video/src/data/timings.json  — [{ id, startSec, audioSec, endSec, startFrame, endFrame }] at 30 fps
timing.targetRuntime: 4:45 to 5:30. If outside, adjust ONLY pauseAfter values proportionally (never the text) and report it.

bed.level: Play under the whole video at about -26 dB relative to the voice (Remotion volume ≈ 0.18). Fade in over the first 2 s, fade out over the end card.
bed.silence: On every line whose sfx is 'silence' (L052): ramp the bed to 0 over 0.3 s at line start, keep it at 0 for the whole line plus its pause, ramp back over 1.0 s.

sfx.placement: Each line's `sfx` plays at that line's start frame. Directive and addendum cards use 'stamp' timed to the moment the card's number lands (≈ 8 frames after the line starts). Every 'scan' transition also plays 'scan' at the transition start.
sfx.tickRule: For 'tick': repeat tick.wav once per second for the length of the line (clock shots).

master.loudness: After rendering, normalise to -14 LUFS integrated, true peak -1.5 dB: ffmpeg -i out/<slug>.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v copy out/<slug>-final.mp4
